  • ASUS's products used to create a build

  • The ROG STRIX Z790-I GAMING WIFI is a very high-end mini ITX. Instead of the classic 4 slots, there are only two that support DDR5 ram in overclock. Another plus point is that it supports all the latest and penultimate generation CPUs. Even on the connectivity side, we are at the top. Finally, we were impressed by the ROG hive accessory that we can plug into the motherboard and which allows us to avoid putting our hands on the motherboard when updating the bios.

  • For this build, we chose the ROG STRIX Z790-I Gaming WiFi motherboard that the company sent us. It has a really rich set of ports with a nice external dongle that further expands the available ports.

  • Asus went a step further with the Z790-I Gaming WiFi board and offered the market the most powerful and well-equipped Mini ITX board for powerful HTPCs, as well as gaming machines.

  • The fact that we gave as many as three awards for this model also speaks of how good the motherboard is.
